title: Crackdown
subtitle: 「嚴厲打擊／加強執法」，究竟是哪一種 crackdown？
description: 「嚴厲打擊／加強執法」，究竟是哪一種 crackdown？

words.note: 最直接的近義詞之一，尤其常見於英式英語，表示政府、警方或機構對違規／違法活動採取更嚴厲措施。
words.example: The city announced a clampdown on illegal parking.
words.exampleZh: 市政府宣布嚴厲打擊違例泊車。

exercises.original: The city announced a crackdown on illegal parking.
exercises.zh: 市政府宣布嚴厲打擊違例泊車。
exercises.upgrade: clampdown · 嚴厲打擊；強力整頓

options.explanation: clampdown on 與 crackdown on 幾乎同義，尤其在英式新聞語境中自然，表示執法力度明顯加強。
regulation 指規管制度或規則本身，不表示市政府開始嚴打違規。
raid 是具體突擊搜查，違例泊車通常不是 raid 的典型對象。
ban 表示禁止某事；此處違例泊車本來已屬違規，重點是加強執法。
政治壓迫色彩太強，完全不適合普通泊車執法。
enforcement 可描述執法，但不自帶「突然／明顯加強」意味，因此不如 clampdown 精確。

exercises.original: Police launched a crackdown on unlicensed street vendors.
exercises.zh: 警方展開對無牌街頭小販的嚴打。

options.explanation: police + launched + on illegal activity 是 clampdown 的典型搭配。
只是規管制度，不等於警方集中行動。
檢查可能是其中一項措施，但範圍比 clampdown 窄。
語氣過強，通常涉及政治／群體壓制。
compliance 是遵守規定，不是打擊行動。

exercises.original: The government began a crackdown on companies that repeatedly ignored safety rules.
exercises.zh: 政府開始強力整頓反覆無視安全規則的公司。

options.explanation: 反覆違規後政府採取更嚴厲措施，完全符合 clampdown。
表示放鬆規管，意思相反。
只是禁止，未表達執法加強。
不合商業安全監管語境。
是企業遵守規則的狀態。

words.meaning: 嚴格執法；嚴厲執行規定
words.note: 表示規則、法律或政策被更嚴格地執行，語氣較中性、制度化。
words.example: Strict enforcement of the new rules begins next month.
words.exampleZh: 新規定將於下月開始嚴格執行。

exercises.original: The crackdown consists mainly of applying the existing rules much more consistently.
exercises.zh: 這次行動主要是更一致、更嚴格地執行現有規則。
exercises.upgrade: strict enforcement · 嚴格執法；嚴厲執行規定

options.explanation: 核心線索是 existing rules + applied more consistently，重點在規則被嚴格執行。
規則本身沒有改變，句子談的是執行。

exercises.original: Authorities said the crackdown would focus on making sure every business followed the licensing rules.
exercises.zh: 當局表示，這次行動重點是確保每間企業都嚴格遵守牌照規定。

options.explanation: making sure every business followed rules 指向規則執行，而不是制定新規則。
可能是執法工具之一，但不是規則持續嚴格執行的總稱。
自願遵守與強制執法不同。

exercises.original: The crackdown reduced violations because inspectors began issuing penalties in every confirmed case.
exercises.zh: 由於檢查人員對每宗確認違規都處罰，嚴格執法令違規減少。

options.explanation: penalties in every confirmed case 表示規則被一致強制執行。
語義過強，不需要「壓制」概念。
只警告比實際 penalties 弱。

words.note: 表示執法力度加強，語氣比 strict enforcement 更強，但仍主要聚焦規則／法律執行。
words.exampleZh: 強硬執法減少了重複違規。

exercises.original: The crackdown included higher fines and immediate penalties for repeat offenders.
exercises.zh: 這次嚴打包括更高罰款和對重犯者即時處罰。
exercises.upgrade: tough enforcement · 強硬執法；嚴格執法

options.explanation: higher fines + immediate penalties 表明執法力度明顯強硬。

exercises.original: Officials defended the crackdown as necessary after repeated violations.
exercises.zh: 官員表示，由於多次違規，有必要採取強硬執法。

options.explanation: repeated violations + necessary stronger response 是「強硬執法」語境。

exercises.original: The crackdown made clear that repeat offenders would no longer receive warnings.
exercises.zh: 這次嚴打表明重犯者不再只收到警告。

options.explanation: 不再只警告而直接採取處罰，表示執法方式變得更強硬。

words.meaning: 執法行動；加強執法行動
words.note: 表示政府或機構在某一段時間內集中資源進行執法。
words.example: Police launched an enforcement drive against unlicensed taxis.
words.exampleZh: 警方展開針對無牌的士的執法行動。

exercises.original: Police launched a crackdown against unlicensed taxis for two weeks.
exercises.zh: 警方展開為期兩週、針對無牌的士的集中執法行動。
exercises.upgrade: enforcement drive · 執法行動；加強執法行動

options.explanation: launched + two weeks + targeted offence 顯示一段時間內集中執法。

exercises.original: The crackdown involved extra inspectors working throughout the month.
exercises.zh: 這次集中執法行動包括整個月增派檢查人員。
exercises.upgrade: enforcement drive · 集中執法行動

options.explanation: extra inspectors + throughout the month 表示集中資源的執法活動。

exercises.original: Authorities described the crackdown as a three-month effort to improve compliance.
exercises.zh: 當局把這次嚴打形容為一項為期三個月、提升守規情況的執法行動。

options.explanation: three-month effort 是 campaign-like enforcement 的直接線索。

words.meaning: 執法運動；集中執法行動
words.note: 與 enforcement drive 接近，但更像有計劃、有時間範圍的政策或執法活動。
words.example: The agency began an enforcement campaign targeting unsafe workplaces.
words.exampleZh: 部門展開針對不安全工作場所的執法行動。

exercises.original: The agency began a crackdown targeting unsafe workplaces across the country.
exercises.zh: 部門展開一項全國性的執法運動，針對不安全工作場所。
exercises.upgrade: enforcement campaign · 執法運動；集中執法行動

options.explanation: nationwide targeted action + agency 是有計劃執法運動的典型語境。
只是宣傳／建議，不是處罰性執法。

exercises.original: The crackdown combined inspections, fines, and public reporting over six months.
exercises.zh: 這次集中執法行動在六個月內結合巡查、罰款和公開通報。
exercises.upgrade: enforcement campaign · 集中執法行動

options.explanation: 多種措施 + 六個月時間範圍，符合計劃性 campaign。
只是一場突擊，範圍太窄。

exercises.original: The regulator called the crackdown a coordinated national effort.
exercises.zh: 監管機構把這次嚴打稱為全國協調的執法行動。

options.explanation: coordinated national effort 直接指大規模、有計劃的執法活動。

words.meaning: 打擊措施；嚴厲整頓措施
words.note: 表示為打擊某問題而採取的一組具體措施。
words.example: New crackdown measures include heavier fines and more inspections.
words.exampleZh: 新的打擊措施包括更高罰款和更多巡查。

exercises.original: The crackdown includes larger fines, more inspections, and licence suspensions.
exercises.zh: 這次打擊措施包括更高罰款、更多巡查和暫停牌照。
exercises.upgrade: crackdown measures · 打擊措施；嚴厲整頓措施

options.explanation: 句子列出具體政策工具，重點是「措施內容」，不是整個事件名稱。
其中有 inspections/fines 等執法，不只是規則。

exercises.original: New crackdown policies require more frequent audits and heavier penalties.
exercises.zh: 新的嚴打措施要求更頻密審計和更重處罰。

options.explanation: audits + heavier penalties 是具體強硬措施。

exercises.original: The government said the crackdown would introduce stronger penalties for repeat violations.
exercises.zh: 政府表示，打擊措施將對重複違規引入更嚴厲處罰。

options.explanation: stronger penalties 是具體整頓措施。

words.meaning: 收緊執法；加強執法力度
words.note: 表示原有執法標準被收緊或執行變得更嚴。
words.example: The tightening of enforcement followed a rise in safety violations.
words.exampleZh: 安全違規增加後，當局收緊了執法。

exercises.original: The crackdown followed several years in which the rules had been applied loosely.
exercises.zh: 多年來規則執行較寬鬆後，當局開始收緊執法。
exercises.upgrade: tightening of enforcement · 收緊執法；加強執法力度

options.explanation: 從 loose implementation 轉為更嚴，是典型 tightening。

exercises.original: Businesses noticed a crackdown as inspectors began checking compliance much more frequently.
exercises.zh: 檢查頻率大增後，企業明顯感受到執法收緊。
exercises.upgrade: tightening of enforcement · 收緊執法

options.explanation: more frequent inspections 表示執法力度逐步變嚴。

exercises.original: The crackdown did not change the law itself; it changed how aggressively the law was applied.
exercises.zh: 這次行動沒有改法律本身，而是收緊了執法力度。
exercises.upgrade: tightening of enforcement · 加強執法力度

options.explanation: law unchanged + application became tougher 是最明確線索。

words.note: 表示監管規則、要求或監督制度變得更嚴格；未必涉及警方行動。
words.example: Regulatory tightening affected several online platforms.
words.exampleZh: 監管收緊影響了多個網上平台。

exercises.original: The crackdown on online platforms mainly involved stricter reporting requirements and licensing rules.
exercises.zh: 針對網上平台的監管收緊主要包括更嚴的報告要求和牌照規則。
exercises.upgrade: regulatory tightening · 收緊規管；監管加強

options.explanation: reporting requirements + licensing rules 都是行政監管，而非警方搜捕。
表示現場大規模搜查，不合。

exercises.original: The crackdown required banks to meet tougher capital and disclosure standards.
exercises.zh: 這次監管收緊要求銀行符合更嚴格的資本和披露標準。

options.explanation: capital/disclosure standards 是金融監管規則，而非警務行動。
銀行資本要求不屬警方執法。

exercises.original: The crackdown increased compliance requirements for technology companies.
exercises.zh: 監管收緊提高了科技公司的合規要求。

options.explanation: compliance requirements 變多／變嚴就是監管收緊。

words.note: 表示警方或執法人員在某地區大規模搜查、拘捕或清查，通常是一次集中行動。
words.example: Police carried out a sweep of several warehouses.
words.exampleZh: 警方對多個貨倉進行掃蕩。

exercises.original: The crackdown involved police searching several warehouses in one night.
exercises.zh: 這次掃蕩涉及警方在一晚內搜查多個貨倉。
exercises.upgrade: sweep · 掃蕩；大規模搜查行動

options.explanation: police + several locations + concentrated search 是 police sweep 的典型語境。

exercises.original: During the crackdown, officers searched dozens of premises and made several arrests.
exercises.zh: 嚴打期間，警員搜查數十個場所並拘捕多人。

options.explanation: multiple searches + arrests = 大規模掃蕩行動。

exercises.original: The crackdown concentrated on one district, where police checked every licensed venue.
exercises.zh: 這次行動集中在一個地區，警方清查所有持牌場所。

options.explanation: one district + every venue 指向全面清查。

words.meaning: 連串突擊搜查；掃蕩行動
words.note: 描述多次 raid 組成的集中執法行動，較具行動性和新聞語感。
words.example: The authorities began a raid campaign against illegal gambling sites.
words.exampleZh: 當局展開針對非法賭博場所的連串突擊行動。

exercises.original: The crackdown involved repeated police raids on illegal gambling sites.
exercises.zh: 這次嚴打包括警方對非法賭博場所進行多次突擊搜查。
exercises.upgrade: raid campaign · 連串突擊搜查；掃蕩行動

options.explanation: repeated raids 是最直接線索，表示多次突擊組成的行動。
非法賭博可能已被禁止，但題目重點是 raids。

exercises.original: The crackdown targeted counterfeit-goods warehouses through a series of coordinated raids.
exercises.zh: 這次嚴打透過一連串協調突擊搜查，針對冒牌貨倉庫。
exercises.upgrade: raid campaign · 突擊掃蕩行動

options.explanation: series of coordinated raids 幾乎直接定義 raid campaign。

exercises.original: The crackdown sent officers to dozens of suspected sites over several days.
exercises.zh: 這次嚴打在數天內派警員突擊多個可疑場所。
exercises.upgrade: raid campaign · 連串突擊行動

options.explanation: dozens of sites + several days 表示多次突擊組成的行動。

words.note: 表示以較強硬方式壓制某活動、行為或現象。語氣可很強，尤其涉及政治抗議或異議時。
words.example: The suppression of the illegal trade involved coordinated police action.
words.exampleZh: 對非法交易的壓制涉及警方協同行動。

exercises.original: The crackdown on the illegal trade involved coordinated police action to stop it operating openly.
exercises.zh: 對非法交易的壓制涉及警方協同行動，以阻止其公開運作。

options.explanation: stop it operating openly 表示主動壓制活動本身，suppression 合適。

exercises.original: The crackdown aimed at stopping a rapidly growing illegal market.
exercises.zh: 這次行動旨在壓制迅速擴大的非法市場。

options.explanation: aimed at stopping the market 表明不只是規管，而是要壓制其活動。
可能只管制其運作，不一定停止。

exercises.original: Authorities described the crackdown as necessary to suppress organized illegal activity.
exercises.zh: 當局表示有必要壓制有組織的非法活動。

options.explanation: 動詞 suppress 已直接提示名詞 suppression。

words.note: 比 suppression 更強烈，通常帶負面政治／人權色彩，指政府或權力機構壓制反對、言論或群體。
words.example: International observers criticized the repression of peaceful dissent.
words.exampleZh: 國際觀察員批評對和平異議的鎮壓。

exercises.original: Human-rights groups criticized the crackdown on peaceful political dissent.
exercises.zh: 人權組織批評對和平政治異議的鎮壓。

options.explanation: peaceful dissent + human-rights criticism 是 repression 的典型強烈政治語境。
語氣過中性，無法表達對和平異議的壓迫性打壓。

exercises.original: Observers said the crackdown went beyond law enforcement and became systematic political oppression.
exercises.zh: 觀察員表示，這次行動已超越一般執法，演變成系統性政治鎮壓。

options.explanation: systematic political oppression 幾乎直接定義 repression。
過於中性，沒有壓迫性政治意味。

exercises.original: Critics called the crackdown on journalists and opposition groups a form of political oppression.
exercises.zh: 批評者把對記者和反對派群體的打壓稱為政治壓迫。

options.explanation: journalists + opposition groups + political oppression 指向 repression。

words.note: 表示對某類違規幾乎不給例外或寬鬆處理，採取嚴格執法。
words.example: The school introduced zero-tolerance enforcement of its anti-cheating rules.
words.exampleZh: 學校對反作弊規則採取零容忍執行。

exercises.original: The school announced a crackdown on cheating in which every confirmed case would receive a penalty.
exercises.zh: 學校宣布對作弊採取零容忍執法，每宗確認個案都會受處分。

options.explanation: every confirmed case would receive a penalty 表示不留寬鬆空間。
選擇性執法與 every case 相反。

exercises.original: The company began a crackdown on safety violations with no exceptions for repeat offenders.
exercises.zh: 公司開始對安全違規採取零容忍執法，重犯者沒有例外。

options.explanation: no exceptions 是 zero-tolerance 的直接線索。

exercises.original: The crackdown means that even minor violations will now be penalized.
exercises.zh: 這次行動意味即使輕微違規也會被處罰。

options.explanation: even minor violations punished 是零容忍標誌。

words.note: 常見口語／新聞表達，表示政府或機構決定對某問題採取更強硬的方式處理。
words.example: The city promised to get tough on illegal dumping.
words.exampleZh: 市政府承諾嚴厲打擊非法傾倒垃圾。

exercises.original: The city promised a crackdown on illegal dumping.
exercises.zh: 市政府承諾嚴厲打擊非法傾倒垃圾。
exercises.upgrade: get tough on · 對……採取強硬措施；嚴打

options.explanation: 這是新聞和日常語境常見慣用語，表示決定對某問題採取更強硬措施。
表示諮詢意見，不是嚴打。
表示放寬規則，意思相反。
容忍，與 crack down 相反。

exercises.original: Officials said they would crack down on repeat tax evaders.
exercises.zh: 官員表示會嚴厲對付重複逃稅者。
exercises.upgrade: get tough on · 嚴厲對付

options.explanation: repeat offenders + tougher response 是 get tough on 的典型新聞語感。
與逃稅者諮詢不是執法。

exercises.original: The regulator decided to crack down on companies that repeatedly failed inspections.
exercises.zh: 監管機構決定對多次未能通過檢查的公司採取強硬措施。
exercises.upgrade: get tough on · 對……採取強硬措施

options.explanation: repeatedly failed inspections 表示當局由一般監管轉向更強硬處理。

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者都表示嚴厲打擊；clampdown 在英式英語尤其常見。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The government announced a crackdown on tax evasion. The government announced a clampdown on tax evasion.

falseSynonyms.zh: enforcement 只是執法／執行規則；crackdown 通常暗示力度明顯加強。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Enforcement of the rule is routine. A crackdown begins when authorities sharply intensify enforcement.

falseSynonyms.zh: regulation 指規則制度本身；crackdown 是對違規行為採取的強硬行動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON New regulation sets stricter standards. A crackdown targets those who break the rules.

falseSynonyms.zh: raid 常是具體的一次警方突擊搜查；crackdown 可以包含多次 raids、罰款和其他措施。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Police carried out a raid on one warehouse. A wider crackdown involved dozens of raids and inspections.

falseSynonyms.zh: ban 是禁止某行為；crackdown 是加強執行法律或規定。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The city introduced a ban on street racing. Police later launched a crackdown on illegal races.

falseSynonyms.zh: suppression 可描述對活動本身的壓制；crackdown 在一般執法新聞中較中性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Police launched a crackdown on counterfeit goods. The suppression of peaceful protest carries a much stronger political meaning.

falseSynonyms.zh: repression 多指系統性壓迫或鎮壓，不適合普通交通、商業或規例執法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There was a crackdown on illegal parking. Human-rights groups condemned political repression.

falseSynonyms.zh: crackdown 是名詞；crack down 是動詞片語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The authorities announced a crackdown. The authorities decided to crack down on violations.
